name: PuppyGraph
title: puppygraph.com
payoff: Query Relational Data As A Graph
shortDescription: PuppyGraph allows users to query relational data as a graph in real-time, eliminating the need for complex ETL processes. It integrates natively with various data sources and is deployable within 10 minutes. Ideal for industries like cybersecurity and healthcare, it supports complex queries and petabyte-level scalability. Example use case: A healthcare provider uses PuppyGraph to analyze complex data relationships to improve patient care efficiency.
cons: Potential learning curve for new users

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Neo4j
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Popular graph database with robust features
